sections.heading: Rules of the road: first part — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: rules of the road: first part within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Reasonable speed; Right of way; Traffic lights; Sign meanings. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Text-supported reasonable-speed, priority, signal and sign-class rules are covered. Images on the speed table contain values absent from extracted text; those image-only values remain typed debt rather than learner facts. Unlabelled individual sign graphics and their visual recognition remain deferred. No image is reproduced and no visual-recognition coverage is claimed.
